_format.settings: Optional overrides of the script defaults, named exactly as in SKILL.md, e.g. {"SITE": "ruin", "STAIR_RISER_MAX": 0.25, "RULES_OFF": "exits"}. Then --profile and --site, then --set (later wins). Unknown names are an error.
_format.accepted: Deliberate conditions: [{"rule": "dead_end", "space": "vault", "reason": "strongroom, one door by design"}]; use "link" for a link id; omit both to accept a rule everywhere. Rule ids: reach, return, sealed, exits, dead_end, dead_share, loop, funnel, vertical, door_width, corridor_width, large_width, headroom, step, guard, stair, tube, small, openings.
_format.spaces: id (unique), kind (exterior | room | chamber | corridor | passage | landing | stair | roof | deck | yard | void), storey (integer, ground 0, basement -1), area (m2); optional: x, y (plan position, m), length and width (corridors and passages, m), headroom (m), edge_drop (largest fall from a walkable edge, m) with guarded (true if a guard is there), crawl (true for deliberate low spaces), anchor (true for the main space), sealed (true for closed voids), large_route. Exactly one space is the outside world (kind exterior).
_format.links: a, b (space ids), kind (door | opening | stair | ramp | lift | ladder | hatch | climb | swim | squeeze | window | drop; window = one a player climbs through; drop = one-way from a to b); optional: id, width (clear, m), headroom (m), face (any label, for links to the exterior), x, y (plan position, m), step (level change at a door, m), riser, tread (m), risers (count) and spiral (true) for stairs, crawl, large_route. Model each stair flight as a stair link between the two spaces it joins; any non-drop link between two storeys is a vertical route.
